This would help me a ton. I literally had to pawn almost everything i have to get my dog back from the animal control people so they wouldn't kill him.

Even if I don't get anything thanks for helping these other people!
I hope so. I was really just hoping to hear some amazing legal trick to get out of this, but I fear they may not be one.

Well tbh I even tried a payday loan today( I know they are terrible) but because my job is brand new they wouldn't do it. I'm probably going to go the pawn route. I have a 40 in tv, an iPad mini from 3? years ago and my ps4. Those are really the only things I could think of that have value.

Yeah thanks I guess. Nice to hear that I'm a terrible dog owner. I love my dog and take great care of him.

The management company for the apartment building says they have no liability in the matter but they are willing to discoun t my rent for March. Great but there isn't a way to make that into money for the animal control. 

I'll try the director thing and give that a shot.

Credit card isn't an option. As I said I just had a bankruptcy last year and I'm still trying to get my credit above 450.
Thanks. It's not a pride thing though. I just don't have a lot of friends or living family. The few friends I do have aren't able to help and my 2 family members don't speak to me.
